brief: Breakout opportunity: AI-powered job search and application tool (ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search).
Emerging trend: 100+ open-source AI agents and RAG apps (Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps).
Act now: AI job search tool has breakout potential, while LLM apps trend is emerging.
Focus on job search tool for immediate impact, but monitor LLM apps for future opportunities.

items.name: ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search
items.one_liner: AI-powered job search and application tool
items.pain_point: Job seekers struggle with tailoring applications and interviews; recruiters need efficient screening
app_ideas: Freemium web app for job seekers with AI-generated CVs and cover letters
B2B API for recruiters to integrate AI screening into their ATS
Chrome extension for job boards with AI-powered application assistance
items.monetization: Freemium with premium features for job seekers; B2B API licensing for recruiters
items.why_now: Increased demand for AI tools in job search and recruitment
